description: Boeing 737-2E1 c/n 21112/424 (ex Eastern Provincial, Aer Lingus EI-BDY, Ladeco CC-CYT), Southern Winds 'Región de Cuyo' from 2002, stored at Córdoba 2005; fuselage moved to Oncativo in September 2022 and converted into the '1880' nightclub building, scheduled to open 9 December 2023. A commercial venue, not a museum.
